view_notes: east profile (nose to screen RIGHT): the character's anatomical LEFT is the FAR side and her right side is near. Upper-left screen light is preserved, so the screen-left back plane of the auburn crown, coat and face is lit and the screen-right front plane is shaded. Auburn hair with upper-left sheen, side-swept fringe toward the front and a loose near lock; low braided coil at the nape behind the far ear. Cool grey-white medical scarf wound at the neck with the knot at the near front and the long tail down the far back. Ivory open clinician coat with the charcoal underdress placket in the near-front gap, pale grey-white apron with botanical hem motif, slim leather belt with brass buckle and far-back medicine pouch. Dark-red emergency bag with brass clasp, leather handle and rolled bandage on the anatomical LEFT hip: only partly exposed behind the back hip at screen LEFT, not a near-side bag. Small green herb sprig at the near right chest with tips past the coat front edge. Near right arm in an ivory sleeve, pale cuff and dark glove at the apron waist; far left arm occluded, with a glove hint at the far bag. Brown leather boots with the near right boot forward and the far left boot darker and set back, brass eyelet.
authored_deviations_from_sheet: East is an authored profile in forward coordinates; it is not a horizontal mirror, rotation, squash, recolour or upscale of the west package. Upper-left screen light is preserved rather than mirrored, and the bag stays on the anatomical left (far) hip.
The concept sheet's white head-veil is omitted so the Bible's low auburn braided coil remains readable; the canonical grey-white medical scarf is worn at the neck with its tail down the far back.
The sheet's long dark-red shawl is reduced to the canonical dark-red emergency bag; in the east profile the far-left bag is deliberately only partly exposed behind the back hip.
In strict east profile the character's far left arm is occluded by the torso; only a glove hint shows at the far bag, while the near right hand rests at the apron waist.
The herb sprig is kept at the near right chest (its canonical side) with tips past the coat front edge, an explicit readability choice in profile.
Fine embroidery, bag contents, tassels and multiple belt charms beyond the botanical hem motif, brass clasp and rolled bandage are omitted for 48 px readability.
